beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Preview OCR now runs away from the GUI thread so extracting names and tags keeps the app responsive.
• A diagnostic GUI hang watchdog records thread stacks when the interface stalls, helping identify the cause of future freezes.

Fixes:
• Fixed PaddleOCR native calls racing when multiple OCR jobs run at once; calls are now serialized to prevent native crashes.
• Fixed OCR retry state being lost when a preview image is converted to PDF during the asynchronous extraction flow.

stable.notes:
New in this version:
• Missing Schoology work now offers a direct assignment link and a Reload action in the center of the viewer.
• Reload checks Schoology again and downloads newly submitted work automatically.

Fixes:
• Fixed course-card clicks opening a different student's course or assignment. The selected student and course now stay together through grading.
• Fixed missing-assignment links sending signed-in teachers to the generic Schoology login page.
